title: oenothera amoena f. roseoalba
intro: Oenothera amoena f. roseoalba, commonly known as a variety of Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Onagraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include relief from menopausal symptoms, such as hot flashes and mood swings, as well as alleviation of skin conditions like eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera amoena f. roseoalba include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid with potential anti-inflammatory effects.
